text.comment: We must coordinate with the administrator of the Provinces Adrift before we can continue onwards with our expedition.
Who does this fool think he is?!
Does he not understand the gravity of our mission?
Withholding his consent?! We shall continue without it if necessary.
And who are you, for that matter, to tell me to calm myself?!
I appreciate your contributions to our mission, but do not forget that I am still your superior!
It is not I who is the issue here, but him!

text.comment: Hmm... You may have a point.
Perhaps his simple mind cannot grasp all the variables at play.
I wonder if we can help him to see the bigger picture.
Yes, you are right. That much is obvious.
But I cannot help but wonder if there is more to the issue than that.
Perhaps he is overly attached to his role as prime administrator of the Provinces.
A reunion with Kingdom End would inevitably result in him having to relinquish standing and power...
Ah, I understand.
He is worried that our presence will stir up an infestation of the chitterers?
The Alliance of the Word is certainly prepared to provide assurances that our investigation will not leave him exposed to Kha'ak attacks.
Well, we are a scientific expedition, so our offensive options are rather limited in that regard.
What we can do, however, is assure that any valuable equipment that is transported into Boron space will be well-guarded to make for an unappealing target.
Furthermore, I am prepared to place several scouts at his disposal. And to establish a network of satellites in Watchful Gaze.
That will give the Split cause to reconsider an incursion into the Provinces.
The situation with this steward does indeed seem resolvable. Though I fear he wears my patience thin.
Take this matter in hand. Go and see the fool. Perhaps you can change his mind.

Hello again, explorer.
I am so very sorry that you had to witness that embarrassingly discordant display.
Leda We and I disagree on much, but he is not a bad person, you know?
He is just... scared.
I think... he is scared of falling short.
He carries the weight of expectations of the entire Provinces. He wants to keep everyone safe, and I think he fears your expedition will exacerbate an already dangerous situation.
Yes. Fraught with danger.
The Provinces lie uncomfortably close to Kha'ak territory.
When Sanctuary of Darkness, first connected to the Provinces, it triggered regular attacks.
We barely managed to protect ourselves the meagre military we could cobble together.
Thankfully the waves have calmed for now. The Kha'ak incursions eventually ceased.
All attempts to communicate with these enigmatic creatures has failed.
So I must hesitate to call it a ceasefire. It is more of a lull in hostilities.
As you can imagine, the situation remains rather fragile.
Oh, you took note of that, did you?
Again and again I approached Leda We for the resources to find our way back home.
But he has come to the conclusion that efforts spent on this endeavour come at an immediate cost to our people.
I would hate you to get the impression that I do not care for my fellow Boron here.
Out on the fringes, I am truly seeking to make a difference for the people.
Serving the Queen's subjects is a duty for me.
You see... I do not like to draw much attention to it, but I am myself the progeny of stranded minor royals.
Before you bow or anything like that, I am not part of the direct line of succession!
And that is not how our monarchy works, in any case.
Yet it drives me to find a path back home. For the people to once again delight in a reunited, merry realm.
The Boron Adrift have suffered too much. We must focus on rebuilding what we have.
Ah. The silent one from our disappointing introduction.

text.comment: Your expedition Commander hardly seemed in the mood for positive solutions.
I cannot imagine you can presume to speak for him.
Assistant. Perhaps uncovering more context first may help with your solutioneering?

add_player_choice.comment: Perhaps there is a positive solution?
Why are you in this situation?

text.comment: I... regret my approach at our meeting. You see... I haven't hosted a diplomatic function in decades.
Unfortunately, I am simply not in the habit of communicating with anyone other than Boron. You see?
We Boron converse amongst ourselves, we rely on complex structures of pheromones. Not just mere words.
There was so much to communicate. So much to cogitate upon...
Yet the words failed me in their conveyance.
You must imagine it like painting an ocean. Yet having only a single shade of blue with which to do so.

add_player_choice.comment: Why are you in this situation?

text.comment: You are correct, of course. There is no harm in reaching for common ground.
I am ashamed to say our defensive capabilities are woefully inadequate. Ashamedly so.
Our economy is so fractured, we struggle to construct anything larger, perhaps, than a frigate.
We cannot even resource and operate a full-scale shipyard.
For half a century of isolation we have had little need for a comprehensive military. I fear we are wholly unprepared for the myriad dangers lurking beyond the gate.
And should word spread of the valuable equipment and facilities proposed by the Alliance of the Word...
It might be akin to painting a target upon ourselves to the nefarious actors abroad.
One moment... I have even now received word of Split incursions.
If we had anything of value to loot, we would not be discussing skirmishes. They would descend upon us in hordes.

And should word spread of the valuable equipment and facilities proposed by the Alliance of the Word...
It might be akin to painting a target upon ourselves to the nefarious actors abroad.
Pirates from across the network would converge upon us like Ma-nola smelling blood in the water.

add_player_choice.comment: Why are you in this situation?

text.comment: From time to time I spend the waking nights pondering the very same question.
It would be misleading to cast blame for all our miseries on the great shutdown.
In fact... When we were first riven from the wider network, the vast majority of out Boron systems remained connected.
Isolated from external threats, we commenced a new age of reflection and scientific endeavour.
And while this period of peace brought the wealth of Kingdom End to fabulous new heights...
...we were not complacent. Resources were stockpiled throught the queendom... A precautionary measure.
Oh, we thought we were prepared!
Yet, in truth, we were far from it.
We Boron are inherently connected to each other, you see? We thrive on a collective sort of... intimacy.
Once that connection was severed, each system found itself in complete isolation. Things fell apart quite quickly, I am afraid to say.
Productivity collapsed catastrophically.
Stockpiles were depleted far more rapidly than anticipated. And there was no way to replenish them.
After years of disarray, Great Reef finally reconnected with Barren Shores. Later, joined by several other systems.
The Provinces Adrift were founded. But by then the damage was done. We still lacked crucial resources.
I contend it was the collective psychological toll of the severance that caused this. More so than the evident logistical challenges posed by the shutdown.

add_player_choice.comment: Why are you in this situation?
...use Nila's ties to further your personal agenda
...aid in securing entry from outside intruders
...we assure to avoid provocaction at all cost'
...we use military escort to wipe them out

text.comment: I am fully aware of Nila Ti's royal connections.
Is it your opinion of me that I am some petty functionary who can be bought and sold. Bribed? By the highest bidder?!
You misjudge me and you misjudge Nila Ti. For all our disagreements, I cannot conceive she would be party to such a grubby approach.
Of course I desire the return of the Provinces Adrift to the warm embrace of the homeworld.
But what kind of servant would I be if I did so at the cost of billions dead or starving?
Well well, this is an unexpectedly kind offer from the Alliance of the Word.
I must admit. Security assistance in these uncertain times would indeed be a welcome reassurance.
Your commendable commitment to peace is as welcome as it is unexpected.
The Alliance of the Word is to be lauded for its respect for our peaceful ways.
Wiping them out is your solution?
To simply exterminate a race?
I understood you entered our provinces in pursuit of scientific enlightenment, not bloodshed!
You casually countenance atrocities as though they were insignificant.
Were you brainwashed by the militants of Sol?
Do these fins look like Terran appendages to you?
Not all the inhabitants of this galaxy are driven by unmoderated barbarity.
No thank you. If we can maintain peace, we shall do so.

text.comment: I find no reassurance in your words. Only distaste.
My principal concern is the welfare of the Boron of the Provinces. Your expedition will expose them to needless jeopardy.
Leda We. This is Numanckaret.
You have underestimated both the influence of the Alliance of the Word and the importance to the network to reconnect with Kingdom End.
As we speak, our representatives are in conference with our allies. The agenda is how - and indeed whether - there should be trade with the Provinces Adrift.
Your ludicruous obstruction leaves me no choice but to twist your arms... uh, fins.
If your economy is your priority, then I hold the keys to unlock it.
Blackmail? You, Numanckaret, are no scientist. You are a brigand and a charlatan!
And yet you leave me no choice but to accede to your dangerous demands.
But mark my words. You have made no friends here in the Provinces Adrift. Some day you may regret that.

text.comment: I must say how thoroughly reassured I am.
And again, please accept my most profound apologies for our earlier... miscommunication?
Clearly, our values are in auspicious alignment. I am confident you will esure no harm befalls my charges.
Please. Do proceed with my blessing and my people's support for the success of your historic mission.
This is all terribly challenging.
My instinct is that your expedition is honest in its intent. However, I find your judgment questionable.
I feel that I must allow you to proceed in your mission.
However... I ask of you... Do not make me regret this.
With the gate in Watchful Gaze reactivated, to our knowledge, only two dormant gates remain in province space.
One is located in Oceans of Fantasy(same as {}), the other was discovered by scouts in Sanctuary of Darkness.
If Sanctuary of Darkness sounds foreboding, you may find that the name is fitting. It hosts to a significant Kha'ak infestation.
eurgh... Even uttering the name makes my fins tingle. Yet I must remain firm on the matter.
Do not, under any circumstances, engage with the Kha'ak. Every interaction with them results in horrific conflict.
You have our word, Leda We.
We shall do everything in our power to avoid undue provocation.
Thank you.

text.comment: What can I do for you, esteemed explorer?
Ah, of course!
Thanks to your valuable contribution, we are now able to establish a Jump Gate research facility.
In theory, for a connection between Jump Gates, one needs the correct coordinates, energy and a means to interface with the technology.
Due to the cache you analysed, we have the directional information from here to Kingdom End.
Next, we set up a mechanism by which we can power the gate.
The Boron of Kingdom End have explained how this can be achieved.
Fortunately, deciphering the technology to enable that has been the focus of their research so far.
While we are establishing the facility, the science team is concurrently working on the local environmental baseline...
Taking in to account spacetime warping from nearby stellar bodies and so forth.
All that will take some time, but we already know it can be done.
In fact, we have done it before! Several times!
The most significant hurdle... we just cannot seem to overcome... is the Jump Gate technology interface.
It is an incredibly complex process... but think of it as some sort of activation command.
Frankly, making progress on that will be a significant challenge.
I am uncertain if that is even within our technological capabilities.
Sadly, we have nothing more for you to do at the moment.
Our scientists are busy setting everything up.
I wonder what exactly is exercising Boso Ta's ballast glands quite so thoroughly...
Oh, please do be cautious! Do not give me cause to regret helping you!

text.comment: In order to launch a Spacesuit Bomb(Spacesuit Bomb same as {20201,12201}), you will first need to get close to the target in your spacesuit.
Next, select the target and then use $INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_PRIMARY_WEAPONGROUP$ to cycle through your weapon groups until the Bomb Launcher(Bomb Launcher same as {20113,1031}) is selected.

With your Bomb Launcher(Bomb Launcher same as {20113,1031}) selected, cycle through the available bomb types with $INPUT_ACTION_CYCLE_NEXT_ACTIVE_WEAPON_AMMO$ until you reach the Spacesuit Bomb(Spacesuit Bomb same as {20201,12201}).
Finally, launch the Spacesuit Bomb(Spacesuit Bomb same as {20201,12201}) with $INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON$.
Alternatively, you can also launch the Spacesuit Bomb(Spacesuit Bomb same as {20201,12201}) in the direction indicated by your cursor with $INPUT_STATE_FIRE_PRIMARY_WEAPON_AT_CURSOR$.
